package section

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// GetSection returns a section.
type GetSection struct {
	Sections    repository.SectionRepository
	SectionI18n repository.SectionI18nRepository
}

func (uc GetSection) Handle(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.Section, []domain.SectionI18n, error) {
	item, err := uc.Sections.Get(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	var translations []domain.SectionI18n
	if uc.SectionI18n != nil {
		translations, err = uc.SectionI18n.ListBySection(ctx, id)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, err
		}
	}
	return item, translations, nil
}

// ListSectionsInput controls section list scope.
type ListSectionsInput struct {
	ModuleID   string
	ActiveOnly bool
}

// ListSectionsByModule lists all sections or sections for a module.
type ListSectionsByModule struct {
	Sections repository.SectionRepository
	Modules  repository.ModuleRepository
}

func (uc ListSectionsByModule) Handle(ctx context.Context, in ListSectionsInput) ([]domain.Section, error) {
	var (
		items []domain.Section
		err   error
	)
	if in.ModuleID != "" && uc.Modules != nil {
		if _, err := uc.Modules.Get(ctx, in.ModuleID); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if in.ModuleID == "" {
		items, err = uc.Sections.ListAll(ctx)
	} else {
		items, err = uc.Sections.ListByModule(ctx, in.ModuleID)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !in.ActiveOnly {
		return items, nil
	}
	result := make([]domain.Section, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.Status == domain.SectionStatusActive {
			result = append(result, item)
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

// DeleteSection marks a section inactive.
type DeleteSection struct {
	Sections repository.SectionRepository
}

func (uc DeleteSection) Handle(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	if id == "" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return uc.Sections.Delete(ctx, id)
}
